title.zh: 受保护场所第 2 号命令 2024
title.vi: Sắc lệnh Khu vực được bảo vệ số 2 năm 2024
title.th: คำสั่งสถานที่ที่ได้รับการคุ้มครอง ฉบับที่ 2 พ.ศ. 2567
title.id: Perintah Tempat yang Dilindungi Nomor 2 Tahun 2024

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-49-2024-PROTECTED-PLACES-NO.-2-ORDER-2024.pdf》（3 页），本次切分 3 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Protected Places (No. 2) Order, 2024 and shall commence on the date it is made.

The place specified in the first column of the Schedule, which is more particularly described in the plan specified in the second column thereof deposited in the office of the Surveyor-General, is hereby declared to be a protected place for the purposes of the Act. Authority

The authority specified in the third column of the Schedule is from whom permission to enter the protected place is to be received.

SCHEDULE (paragraphs 2 and 3) Place Plan Number Authority Building and area GT200001BM Commissioner of Police. Pasukan Gerak Khas Royal Brunei Police Force Mukim Berakas B Brunei and Muara District Made this 7th. day of Jamadilakhir, 1446 Hijriah corresponding to the 9th. day of December, 2024.

DATO SERI SETIA AWANG HAJI AHMADDIN BIN HAJI ABDUL RAHMAN Minister of Home Affairs. Dicetak oleh Print Plus Sdn. Bhd., Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam.
